normal_manual_design.actual_maximum: For actual k=1..16: r=min(20,ceil(5*k/4)); full group has k16+r20 and 125% parity overhead; original source always immediately sent.
normal_manual_design.requested: Same parity row count r per group; first approximately half due block-close+30ms and second half due block-close+100ms, no Auto.

full_block_user_scheme.full_16_original_erasure_if_first_10_rep: FAIL; ten late rows cannot restore sixteen missing originals

candidate_first_prototype.why: Late 18 rows cover up to 16 missing sources with two independent late-row erasure slack; early 2 permit quick recovery of <=2 missing sources.

candidate_alternative.warning: Late 16 rows have no loss slack for full16-original erasure.

extreme_alternative.warning: Better theoretical full-block blackout resilience but every FEC recovery delayed >=100ms.

normal_manual_design.conditional_formula: P(recover | all 16 originals lost, all early repairs lost, n late repairs have independent per-row loss q and are in RX lifetime) = sum over j=16..n C(n,j)(1-q)^j q^(n-j)
normal_manual_design.scope_disclaimer: MODEL_ONLY. Late packets may suffer correlated same-burst erasures, 100ms send deadline/PSI misses, stale block id, RX timeout, replay rejection, or overload; these conditional values do not predict end-to-end packet loss SLA.

memory_illustration_at_100Mbps_app.disclaimer: Rough payload-only average, not actual RSS or capacity; partial groups/headers/bursts are excluded.

hard_product_constraints: Current source Fec2Owner post-close parity job expiry 10ms: must encode promptly then separately hold bounded due work, not sleep an owner worker.
Current Normal Fec2LiveRx block age 150ms after last touched, block reorder window 1024, live blocks <=640 and retained bytes <=48MiB; late rows may be rejected at high rates.
Parity must receive authentic M4 AEAD/PN just before actual send; preseal+100ms risks replay ordering.
First data path, authenticated feedback, FEC row count including partial k, outer DATA repair policy and Stop cleanup unchanged.
Test with one VM matched low-rate A/B under real shared GE and wall-clock blackout, inspect deadline p99, CPU/RSS, late drops, receiver retire; no high load under existing capacity stop.
normal_manual_design.decision: Worth small separately configured manual Normal experiment (outside Auto), but exact 10+10 split not recommended as sole long-blackout design. Initial comparison with 2 immediate and 18 delayed; no Normal code implemented in this turn.
